description: This file declares utility functions for hardware control of a PCIe endpoint device in the Intel SmartPHY DSL Linux driver, including GPIO, clock, reset, and interrupt management functions.

methods.name: dc_ep_clkod_disable
methods.description: Disables the clock of the PCIe endpoint device.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_init
methods.description: Initializes the ICU (Interrupt Control Unit) for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_disable
methods.description: Disables the ICU for the PCIe endpoint.

methods.name: dc_ep_assert_device
methods.description: Asserts (enables or activates) the device with specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_deassert_device
methods.description: De-asserts (disables or deactivates) the device with specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_reset_device
methods.description: Resets the device with specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_on
methods.description: Turns on the clock for the device with specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_off
methods.description: Turns off the clock for the device with specified bits.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_set
methods.description: Sets the clock parameters for the device.

methods.name: dc_ep_clk_get
methods.description: Retrieves current clock settings.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_dir
methods.description: Sets the direction (input/output) for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_set
methods.description: Sets the value of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_get
methods.description: Gets the value of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: dc_ep_pinmux_set
methods.description: Configures pin multiplexing setting for a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_pinmux_get
methods.description: Retrieves the pin multiplexing setting for a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_pupd_set
methods.description: Sets the pull-up/pull-down configuration for a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_od_set
methods.description: Sets open-drain configuration for a GPIO.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_src_set
methods.description: Configures GPIO source.

methods.name: dc_ep_gpio_dcc_set
methods.description: Sets GPIO DCC (Drive Capability Control).

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_dis_intr
methods.description: Disables specified ICU interrupts.

methods.name: dc_ep_icu_en_intr
methods.description: Enables specified ICU interrupts.
